notes: FDL-Editor: the value list on a setting now shows its real options (00, 01 ...) instead of a single "." and sets the one you pick. Clicking away changes nothing. Keys tab: type a value and press Enter, it is set right away, no Apply needed. Right-click Restart works on more modules and cars, through E-Sys's own connection. Secure coding is now only marked on modules that really need it. A clear message when EDIABAS cannot start on the PC. Smoother SVT tree on large cars.
